sources: Brigand's Calling (batch 4, written with Tangtang's kit: docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0027_tangtang.md). rmxlinux Json/SkillData/sk_wpn_pistol_0011 (weapon skill 3, SkillPatchTable L1–L9: cryst_dmg_up 0.16–0.448, cryst_dmg_up2 0.20–0.56, spell_damage_taken_up 0.06–0.168, duration 20, duration2 20): cardAttributeModifier attribute 53 formulaItem 5 +cryst_dmg_up (Cryo DMG, stat panel). passiveEventActions: abilityEvent 126 (the wielder applies an Arts Infliction) + CheckOriginSkillType [2, 7] (battle skill, ultimate) + CheckSpellInflictionType mask 4 (Cryo) → buff_wpn_pistol_0011_valid on the wielder (attribute 53 +cryst_dmg_up2, `duration`, stackingType 2 max 1); abilityEvent 206 (the wielder applies a buff) + tag 1427729990 (Susceptibility) + CheckOriginSkillType [2, 7] → buff_wpn_pistol_0011_valid2 on the target (DamageScaleProcessor side 1 NormalCalcZone +spell_damage_taken_up, CheckDamageTypeMask 92: Heat, Electric, Cryo, Nature; `duration2`; stackingType 1, maxStackCnt 1).

"When the wielder applies Cryo Infliction via battle skills or ultimates, the wielder gains Cryo DMG Dealt +{cryst_dmg_up2} for {duration}s. When the wielder's battle skill or ultimate applies Arts Susceptibility, the target enemy suffers Arts DMG Taken +{spell_damage_taken_up} for {duration2}s. The two effects apply separately and do not stack with themselves." fixtures/zmdlogs-b7b3762d5da8.json (Tangtang, skill level 5) lists both from her battle skill's first Waterspout tick on (boundary entries at 11276 ms, then on every hit).
